in_hebrew.name: חיידה

in_greek.name: Ἡιδη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Heyde in Greek is derived from the Greek word Ἡδυς (hedys), which means 'joy'. The name Heyde can be translated as 'joyful one' or 'bringer of joy'.

in_latin.name: Heydeia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Heyde in Latin is derived from the Latin word heydeus, which means 'noble'. The name Heyde can be translated as 'noble one' or 'honorable one'.
